title: Judge blocks Trump's 250-foot arch near Arlington over lack of congressional approval
summary_full: In a significant ruling, a federal judge has barred the construction of a controversial monument near Arlington National Cemetery. This decision follows an earlier temporary injunction from another judge, with local government and community members expressing strong concerns regarding the monument's potential effects. The Trump administration aims to appeal this ruling, defending their vision for the monument amidst ongoing debates over presidential authority regarding national landmarks.
